title: Ask Richter
subtitle: My Interactive AI CV (100% Serverless RAG Architecture)
summary: Interactive resume powered by 100% Serverless RAG, Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase, pure TypeScript hybrid vector and lexical search (TSVectorStore), and multilingual M15 engine.
overview:
A traditional resume tells what you did in the past, but what if it could converse, reason, and demonstrate your knowledge in real time? Ask Richter was born from this premise: transforming a static professional career into a dynamic and interactive dialogue experience. It is an AI chatbot specialized in my career, built on a 100% Serverless Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture.

More than just a portfolio, this project is a 'SaaS-like' application and a practical demonstration of the AI Engineering Framework v2.1. Powered by a multilingual RAG engine (M15), the platform detects the user's language (Portuguese, English, or Spanish) and orchestrates vector and lexical searches to formulate factual and precise responses. The entire architecture was engineered to run on the Vercel cloud (Next.js App Router) communicating with Supabase and provider-agnostic AI engines (such as Gemini and local Ollama), combining product innovation with strict governance, scope isolation (WSCI), and infrastructure resilience.
roleDescription: As AI Solutions Architect & Full-Stack Developer, I worked end-to-end on the project, taking on the following key responsibilities:
responsibilities: Software & Cloud Architect: Designed the 100% Serverless architecture (ADR-0007/0008), eliminating complex native dependencies and ensuring minimal operating costs.
AI Engineer: Implemented the Hybrid RAG layer (Vector and Lexical search), integrated the Provider-Agnostic ecosystem (Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama), and developed multilingual intelligence.
Frontend Developer: Built a modern, reactive, and resilient UI/UX with React 19, Next.js 15, and Framer Motion, ensuring smooth visual feedback even during database cold-starts.
Reliability Engineer (SRE/DevOps): Established strict governance protocols (Zero-Trust, Jidoka/Andon Cord) and the Turborepo CI/CD pipeline.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Volatility of free-tier cloud services, specifically Supabase inactivity pauses that severely degraded the user experience with unpredictable cold starts.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Designed the Operational State Machine (ADR-0009) featuring 7 strict operational states and the Golden Rule of Non-Inference of Pause. When a real pause is detected, the platform orchestrates automated server-side unpausing via the Supabase Management API with sequential polling, progressive backoff, and UI idempotency locks.

futureEvolution: RAG Relevance Telemetry: Implement dashboards and implicit user feedback metrics to continuously fine-tune the accuracy of AI-retrieved chunks.

Continuous Integration with Local Agents: Expand the CI/CD pipeline so the Jidoka engine autonomously runs complex exploratory request simulations using local Ollama models before production deployments.

metrics: Minimized Infrastructure Costs: 100% Serverless architecture eliminating 24/7 dedicated servers, leveraging Vercel, Supabase, and Google AI Free Tiers
High Resilience & Calibrated SLA: Strict 300-second SLA calibrated in production for the database unpause/cold-start cycle with full user transparency
Quality & Test Coverage: Protected by a suite of 65 automated tests across 8 critical modules (resilience, routing, vector parity, and M15)
Performance & UX Engineering: Total elimination of C++ vector search dependencies, replaced by pure TypeScript implementations (TSVectorStore and SimpleTfIdf)

owaspMitigations.title: Cryptographic Failures (Strict Credential Isolation)
owaspMitigations.description: Communication with the Supabase Management API is strictly server-side (via /api/supabase/restore). The administrative token (SUPABASE_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN) remains 100% isolated from the browser under the principle of least privilege.

owaspMitigations.title: Server-Side Request Forgery / SSRF (Secure Routing Invariants)
owaspMitigations.description: Implementation of Production Routing Invariants (Zero Render Fallback) with automatic runtime URL sanitization to force exclusive use of native relative Vercel routes, blocking malicious redirects.

owaspMitigations.title: Broken Access Control (Zero-Trust Agent Governance)
owaspMitigations.description: The Constitutional Agent Specification defines strict operational boundaries for AI during development, using segregated workspaces and two-phase execution (Plan and Execution) requiring mandatory Human Gates.
